frozen_policy.model_and_universe: Candidate E frozen model; exact Coinbase completed-minute state; causal Kalshi ATM plus/minus five; primary net edge threshold $0.02
frozen_policy.quantity_precondition: verify target market accepts the exact fractional quantity and increment before any real-money authorization

exit.resting_protection: one reduce-only GTC exit while long
exit.backend_monitoring: continuously evaluate each fresh valid full remaining bid ladder
exit.dynamic_trigger: confirmed realized net proceeds plus hypothetical full remaining-ladder net proceeds meets or exceeds retained original total net-proceeds target
exit.handoff: cancel resting GTC; await authoritative final order/fill/position reconciliation; recompute remaining full ladder; submit one reduce-only FOK for all remaining quantity only after the resting order is inactive
exit.fok_failure: submit no additional competing exit; restore recalculated reduce-only GTC after authoritative reconciliation

scenario_evaluation.input: closed immutable raw source segments only
scenario_evaluation.purpose: shadow compare frozen and alternative policies without delaying the live decision path
scenario_evaluation.counterfactual_limit: archived books cannot prove queue priority or larger-size fill capacity

post_soak_roadmap: accept successful 24-hour read-only soak and controlled restart evidence
offline-test deterministic hybrid state machine and archived-segment scenario evaluator
freeze exact cash-loss cap, order/fill cap, market scope, duration, price/quantity increment, fee schedule, kill switch, and audit contract
obtain direct user approval for one exact production micro-probe run
run the capped probe and evaluate it without automatic scale-up
demo_policy: optional isolated API-mechanics exercise; it is not a mandatory week-long predecessor to the capped production micro-probe
